tasks.task: For an end-of-day incident review, I need to audit activity tied to a known contract address on Ethereum Mainnet. Using the existing MCP session bcs_sess_01J2Q8K1Y7Q6V9H4X0F3K7R9T2, pull a quick triage for transaction 0x6a1d2c3b4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef (status/participants + any logs), and also confirm whether the contract at 0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000010 exposes standard ERC-20 metadata functions (name/symbol/decimals/balanceOf) so we can decide if it should be treated as a token in the report. This must not rely on ENS resolution (previous attempt failed) and must be completed using only indexed/available explorer data.

success_criteria: Step 2 returns a transaction object for chain_id=1 and hash=0x6a1d2c3b4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef.
Step 3 returns an items array (may be empty) and uses the transaction hash obtained from step 2.
